name: macro_collector-mcp
description: FRED macro series (CSV) (market data): me, get_series, search_symbols. Every tool maps to a document

platform_mcp_macro_collector_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MACRO_COLLECTOR_API_KEY
platform_mcp_macro_collector_api_key.description: FRED API key ('32 character alpha-numeric lowercase string') requested at https://fredaccount.stlouisfed.org/apikeys; sent as the api_key query parameter (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html). Terms: show 'This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.'

tools.name: me
tools.description: FRED has no account endpoint: the key is verified by fetching the docs' own example series (GET /fred/series?series_id=GNPCA); account carries realtime_start/end and seriess[].

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: `start`/`end` are observation_start/observation_end (YYYY-MM-DD); the API's own limit (1-100,000, default 100,000) and offset are not exposed, so one call returns the full range. `value` is the documented numeric string ('.' marks a missing observation); units (lin), frequency and aggregation_method keep FRED's defaults. realtime_start/realtime_end stay in `raw`.

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Full-text search (search_type=full_text default) ordered by search_rank; limit 1-1000 with offset paging and `count` as the total. `type` is the series frequency (e.g. Monthly); units, seasonal_adjustment, observation_start/end, popularity and last_updated stay in `raw`.
